chapter: Dance and brass bands of Alice's youth
title: Quadrilles, waltzes, polkas and lancers
summary: Alice and the interviewers describe how quadrilles were danced and what music went with them, and mention a quadrille played with René and Albert Glenny.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

Quadrilles. Quadrilles. Oh, it's so long since they don't have quadrilles. Quadrilles was pretty, too. Oh, yes. I've seen one. Yeah.
They revived it.
Quadrilles was pretty.
It was... It wasn't a real one. It was special for television. Quadrilles, it was, let's see, three, four men, two men, eh? And four ladies.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
